scope: Classical CAN (CAN CC), not CAN FD-specific CRC/frame rules. Python examples do not simulate full controller or error-counter event changes.

claims.claim: CAN checks bit monitoring, bit stuffing, CRC, frame-form bits and ACK
claims.notes: These are detection classes, not node states

claims.claim: A transmitting node expects a dominant ACK bit from at least one other node receiving the message correctly; silent/listen-only nodes may not acknowledge
claims.notes: ACK is not an application-level delivery receipt; single active transmitter may see repeated ACK errors

claims.claim: Normal arbitration loss, acknowledgment-slot dominant response and dominant overlay of passive error flag are not ordinary bit errors
claims.locator: Transmission Bit Verification, Arbitration, Acknowledgement Slot
claims.notes: Illustrates the limits of send-vs-sample mismatch tests

claims.claim: Dynamic bit stuffing applies from SOF through CRC sequence of Classical CAN; five identical bits imply complementary stuff bit
claims.notes: fixed-form fields and error flags are excluded; exact span also cross-checked with Analog Devices

claims.claim: Classical CAN uses 15-bit CRC; field covers logical SOF to end of data, not CRC sequence itself
claims.locator: CAN CC CRC calculation / CRC sequence
claims.notes: Independent Python polynomial division checks reference function

claims.claim: CRC-15-CAN generator polynomial x^15 + x^14 + x^10 + x^8 + x^7 + x^4 + x^3 + 1, representation 0x4599 without leading term
claims.notes: Constant also matches chapter's pre-existing C implementation

claims.claim: CRC delimiter, ACK delimiter and EOF are fixed-form checked fields with frame end special cases
Active error flag is 6 dominant bits; passive error flag 6 recessive bits; error delimiter nominally 8 recessive bits
claims.locator: Error active / Error passive and error flags
claims.notes: Multiple error flags can superpose, making on-bus duration variable

claims.claim: Error Active TEC and REC under 128; Error Passive if one reaches 128; Bus-Off only if TEC reaches 256
claims.notes: Implemented as deterministic boundary classifier with TEC maximum sentinel 256

claims.claim: An error-warning diagnostic can be indicated at TEC or REC threshold 96 on some controllers
claims.notes: Warning is diagnostic, not fourth error-confinement state

claims.claim: TEC +8 and REC +1 are not unconditional; passive ACK errors and successful receives with REC above 127 have exceptions
claims.notes: Do not use event-based counter increment simulator without full rules

claims.claim: Error-passive node may require extra suspend transmission interval after intermission
claims.locator: Error passive paragraph: Suspend Transmission Field 8 recessive bits
claims.notes: Impacts timing of re-initiation after transmission

claims.claim: Bus-Off recovery requires monitoring 128 occurrences of 11 consecutive recessive bits; controller auto/software choice is implementation-dependent
claims.locator: CAN Error Confinement Rules number 12 and Bus Off paragraph
claims.notes: Not a precise guaranteed fixed-duration timer

claims.claim: CRC15 feedback implementation equals independent integer polynomial long division over all bit strings up to length 10
claims.notes: Tests verify algorithm on synthetic logical bit strings, not real CAN capture

claims.claim: Three original pedagogical diagrams visualize error detection, nominal flags, and fault-confinement states
claims.notes: Illustrative only; no waveform timing or measured physical characteristics
